offering_description.value: TransUnion sells credit reports, risk scores, and identity, fraud, and marketing tools to lenders, other businesses, and government agencies. It combines credit and other data with analytics and delivers the results through reports, software, and data feeds. It also provides credit monitoring and identity protection to consumers.

primary_products.value: Credit reports and risk scores; fraud detection and identity verification software; marketing audience data; consumer credit and identity protection tools

primary_services.value: Credit and identity monitoring; identity theft recovery assistance; tenant and employment screening; marketing audience measurement

customer_segment.value: B2B: Banks, credit unions, fintech lenders, insurers, landlords, employers, telecom providers, advertisers and collection agencies; B2C: Consumers who check or monitor their credit or seek identity protection; B2G: Public agencies that verify identities and detect fraud in government programs

end_markets.value: Consumer lending and payments; insurance; rental housing and employment; telecommunications and advertising; consumer credit and identity protection

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Credit report pulls, risk scores, identity checks and fraud screening queries; subscription: Consumer credit monitoring and identity protection, plus recurring access to business data tools; licensing or royalties: Credit, identity and marketing datasets and analytics licensed to businesses; service fees: Screening, audience measurement and related analytics services
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; subscription; licensing or royalties; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Compiles lender records and other data into credit reports, risk scores and screening results for institutions and consumers; software / platform: Combines client and third-party data in decisioning, fraud detection and marketing tools for businesses and agencies

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Latin America, United Kingdom, Africa and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Credit reporting, risk analytics, identity verification, fraud prevention, marketing data and consumer credit monitoring

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise and public-sector account teams; online: Consumer websites, mobile apps, business portals and APIs; partners / resellers: Lending software providers, screening resellers and financial institutions that offer credit tools to their customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Consumer reporting under the U.S. Fair Credit Reporting Act and personal data handling under applicable privacy laws
